about: The Library's gripper parts (index.html): each part's mesh, licence and the face the page selects (the request's selection, base and border, with seed facets), and its variants (pitch and fill; the page's other options are its defaults).  Written once by the private tools/library_import.py from the multi-gripper video's recipes, then edited by hand; the Robotiq 2F-85 added by hand on 2026-11-16 (MuJoCo Menagerie's robotiq_2f85, the user's decision of that day); the UMI finger's tapered tips (the family umi-tapers) and their meshes come from the private tools/library_tips.py, which cuts them from the HandUMI finger; tools/library_write.py fits every variant and writes entries.json and fits/.
